_notes: Sun-Faded Photo Poster: every colour comes from the photograph; faded gold is headline-only and may never touch a chart.
Charts are drawn with no panel, straight on the open ground, so the 'surface' is whatever field the photo gives (meadow lime #8E9726 is the reference).
Emphasis runs by INK DENSITY, not hue: full weathered ink #292B19 = the series that matters; the same ink at 36% = context. Identity survives CVD and greyscale because it is carried by lightness.

Validated (WCAG + CIELAB, own script; the dataviz validator was not installed): accent vs ground 4.54:1 meadow lime, 5.16:1 dry field, 6.01:1 ploughed earth, 3.09:1 deep grass. dE(accent, muted) 42.0 / 32.8 / 35.5 / 29.1.
Sky-deep blue #0E74AC was tried as the accent and rejected: 1.09-1.82:1 against grass, unreadable on dark fields.
Muted marks sit at ~1.5-1.8:1 against the ground (the sheet wants captions 'almost missed'); the relief is that every mark carries a direct label in full ink.
Ordinal ramp is the same ink at rising density (photo shadow, not an invented hue).
